title: Protecting the Spirit of Sea Country Bill 2023
short_title: Protecting the Spirit of Sea Country Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require offshore oil and gas companies to consult Traditional Owners before submitting project proposals.
It would add First Nations communities and knowledge holders to the legal definition of 'Relevant Person' and create mandatory consultation standards.
The bill responds to a court case where Santos was found not legally required to consult Traditional Owners about a pipeline through their sea country.
changes: Expands the definition of 'Relevant Person' to include Traditional Owners and knowledge holders.
Requires the creation of consultation standards for offshore projects.
Mandates that underwater and intangible cultural heritage be identified in project proposals and environment plans.
Requires evaluation of impacts, risks, and alternative options for offshore projects.
summary.affected: Traditional Owners and First Nations communities, fossil fuel companies, and the offshore petroleum industry.
